t: Magnusson Ladder Roof Hooks are essential ladder accessories designed to convert a standard extension ladder into a secure roof ladder. This robust solution is ideal for roofers, builders, and general tradespeople requiring safe access for roof maintenance, repairs, or installation tasks. Constructed from durable aluminium, the hooks offer a substantial 150kg maximum load capacity, ensuring reliable support during roof work. Sturdy wheels facilitate easy positioning on the roof, and the system is simple to fit to most extension ladders, including single section models. Fixings and fittings are supplied for immediate and straightforward installation.
